land lying in East Nottingham, Cecil coun-
ty, Maryland, on two public roads leading from
the Brick Meeting House to New London Cross
Roads, and from Lancaster to Elkton, one mile
and three quarters from the Brick Meeting
House, six miles from the Cross Roads, about
thirty miles from Lancaster, and eleven miles
from Elkton, on the main Wagon road from
Little Britain Township to Christiana Bridge,
the situation is healthy, pleasant, and hand-
some, and as good a stand for tavern and store, as
there is in the neighbourhood.

There is erected on the premises a large two
story Log House, with store house and kitchen
adjoining, all has been rough cast, good stables,
well of very good water, about Two hundred
Peach Trees, just begun to bear, some other fruit
trees of different kinds about fifteen ACRES OF it
in woodland, and some of the ground laying
handsome for meadow. As it is presumed that
no person will incline to purchase without see-
ing the property, further description is deemed
unnecessary. An indisputable title will be made,
and possession given to suit the purchaser, and
the terms made known by applying to
